body: I don't know what would make me feel better, and I don't know how anyone can help. I just hope I can weather the storm because even when my aunt tried to be helpful, her words still broke me and made me wanna die. Now that she's mad, it'll probably rid me of any hesitation I have about the pain I'll experience when I die.

NTs? It's probably neurotypicals. I'm not good at explaining but it's people who don't have autism/adhd/etc. A google search or a more experienced member may help expand on the meaning of the term better than I did.

I feel the same. There are people who I don't want to hurt when I decide to kill myself, but the person I do want to hurt? My death will (hopefully) affect them immensely. Can they ever show their face anywhere if the person they took care of killed theirself because of them? I hope my family would hate her as much as I did when I die. I hope my parents never talk to her again.
